requirements.title: Unestablished dummy-argument names that are referenced as procedures are dummy procedures
requirements.definition: For an unestablished name that is the name of a dummy argument, the dummy argument is a dummy procedure and the reference invokes the effective argument corresponding to that dummy procedure.

pending.unestablished-dummy-name-is-dummy-proced: Pass module function actual returning 42 to a dummy procedure named cb with no local declaration beyond the dummy role; inside the procedure call cb() and verify 42.
pending.dummy-procedure-reference-invokes-effect: Pass two different actual procedures returning 17 and 42 through the same dummy procedure in separate calls; verify the observed result follows the effective argument, not the dummy name spelling.

requirements.title: Unestablished intrinsic names resolve to intrinsic procedures with matching procedure status
requirements.definition: Otherwise, an unestablished name that is that of an intrinsic procedure resolves to that intrinsic procedure, provided the reference agrees with the intrinsic procedure being a function or subroutine.

pending.unestablished-intrinsic-name-selected: With no declaration for ABS, evaluate ABS(-7) and verify exact 7; companion external ABS returning 49 makes wrong resolution observable.
pending.intrinsic-function-subroutine-status-agr: Use ABS only as a function reference yielding 7. A source-control contrast attempts CALL ABS(-7) and is not a diagnostic facet for this unnumbered rule.

requirements.title: Other unestablished procedure names resolve to external procedures
requirements.definition: Otherwise, an unestablished procedure reference resolves to an external procedure with that name.
